title: TRT/SDS Sol/Insol Fractionation for Lysate Prep from Mouse Brains
author: Kasandra Scholz
materials: Determine protein concentration using BCA assay.

steps.title: Prepare and Weigh Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse brain sample and place it in a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, keeping the tube on dry ice until ready.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using Lysis Buffer containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Add Lysis Buffer at a ratio of 1 ml per 100 mg of tissue.
Allow the sample to thaw briefly.
Homogenize using a motorized tissue grinder at medium speed to avoid excess frothing.
Place homogenized samples on ice.

If using the split-volume method: use 1/2 volume of lysis buffer to homogenize and transfer to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube on ice, then add the remaining 1/2 volume to the original tube, homogenize again to rinse the grinder, and transfer to the same Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Clean Tissue Grinder
steps.instruction: Rinse the tissue grinder thoroughly between different samples.

substeps.instruction: Operate the grinder in two changes of water.
Rinse with 70% ethanol.
Dry with a Kimwipe.

steps.title: Sonicate and Aliquot Total Lysate
steps.instruction: Sonicate the homogenate and reserve a portion as total lysate.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate on ice for 10 seconds using setting '8'.
Set aside 100 µl and mark as 'total lysate'.

steps.title: Prepare Total Lysate for Storage
steps.instruction: Add detergents to the total lysate and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add Triton X-100 to a final concentration of 1% (e.g., 10 µl of 10% Tx-100 to 100 µl homogenate).
Add SDS to a final concentration of 0.1% (e.g., 1 µl of 10% SDS to 100 µl homogenate).
Incubate samples for 30 minutes on ice.
Perform BCA assay, prepare samples, and freeze at -80°C.

steps.title: Extract Triton Soluble Fraction
steps.instruction: Separate the Triton-soluble proteins from the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add Triton X-100 to a final concentration of 1% (e.g., 50 µl of 10% Triton to 500 µl brain homogenate).
Incubate samples for 30 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 60 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant to a fresh tube and label as 'Triton soluble fraction'.

steps.title: Extract SDS Soluble Fraction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet to extract SDS-soluble proteins.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Lysis Buffer + 2% SDS (200 µl per pellet) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors.
If SDS has precipitated due to cold, gently warm for a few seconds to re-dissolve.
Sonicate for 10 seconds.
Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 10 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant to a fresh tube and label as 'SDS soluble fraction'.

steps.title: Store Fractions and Pellet
steps.instruction: Preserve the remaining pellet and the extracted fractions.

substeps.instruction: Save the final pellet at -80°C for formic acid fractionation.
Aliquot each fraction into several tubes to minimize freeze-thawing and store at -80°C.
